ideas.pitch: A high-performance trading intelligence pipeline that combines causal reasoning with low-latency LLM execution to isolate true market drivers from noisy order-book signals.
ideas.problem_statement: Markets & Trading Intelligence / Cause & Effect in AI Decisions
ideas.title: OptiFlow: Low-Latency Execution & Causal Inference Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the dual themes sponsored by IITB-Optiver AI Innovation Lab, this project directly appeals to quantitative finance judges by addressing real-world alpha decay and causal market impact.

ideas.pitch: A competitive multi-agent simulation framework where autonomous LLM agents trade assets under strict liquidity and latency constraints, testing cooperative vs. competitive dynamics.
ideas.title: AgentArena: Multi-Agent Algorithmic Negotiation Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex multi-agent orchestration patterns proven in prior winning systems, directly hitting the multi-agent coordination track evaluated by IIT Bombay researchers.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade trustworthy AI shield that logs and cryptographically verifies every reasoning step an LLM takes to prevent hallucinations and ensure regulatory compliance in high-stakes decisions.
ideas.title: VeritasLLM: Cryptographically Verifiable AI Decision Trails
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a mathematically rigorous approach to AI safety and explainability, scoring exceptionally high on the technical depth and rigor required for Round 1 abstract evaluations.

ideas.pitch: An extremely memory-efficient RAG architecture using custom INT4 quantization and pruned attention heads to run massive domain-specific knowledge bases on resource-constrained edge hardware.
ideas.title: QuantizedRAG: Edge-Optimized Neural Retrieval for Efficient Systems
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves hardware scaling bottlenecks directly relevant to systems engineers at IITB-Optiver, focusing on raw performance metrics rather than surface-level wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interactive tutor that diagnoses conceptual misunderstandings in STEM students through rigorous Socratic questioning rather than just giving direct answers.
ideas.title: SocraticAI: Multimodal Student Diagnostic & Tutoring Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses educational intelligence with a working pedagogical model that academic judges at Techfest IIT Bombay can immediately test and appreciate.
